ns0:metadata.ns0:title: Evaluate to true if the win-def:registry_test is properly supported.
ns0:metadata.ns0:description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the win-def:registry_test.

ns0:notes.ns0:note: It is important to note that the values used in this test definition are specific to a particular machine, and may not necessarily apply to your system. As a result, in order to have the definition return a result of 'true', you must either change these values to the ones found on your particular system, or you must configure your system to use these values.
Information regarding the registry on your particular machine can be found by navigating to Start->Run... and by typing 'regedit'.

ns0:criterion.comment: Test if a registry_object with a hive, key, and name is supported.

ns3:registry_test.comment: Test if a registry_object with a hive, key, and name is supported.

ns3:registry_object.comment: Retrieve a registry_object with a hive equal to 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE', key equal to 'SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion', and name equal to 'CurrentVersion'.
ns3:registry_object.ns3:name: CurrentVersion

ns3:registry_state.comment: This registry_state represents a registry_object with a hive equal to 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE', key equal to 'SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion', and name equal to 'CurrentVersion'.
ns3:registry_state.ns3:name: CurrentVersion
